methodology: Single-variable tuning. Each experiment changes exactly one hyperparameter while holding the corresponding family baseline fixed, so differences can be attributed to that parameter as directly as possible.

spec.name: tune_mlp_hidden_dim_256
spec.description: 增大 MLP 隐层维度，观察容量增加后的效果变化

spec.name: tune_mlp_dropout_0p5
spec.description: 提高 MLP dropout，观察更强正则化的影响

spec.name: tune_cnn_num_filters_64
spec.description: 减小卷积通道数，观察 CNN 容量下降后的影响

spec.name: tune_cnn_filter_sizes_2_3_4
spec.description: 缩小卷积感受野，观察更短 n-gram 模式的提取效果

spec.name: tune_bigru_num_layers_2
spec.description: 增加 BiGRU 层数，观察更深时序建模是否带来收益

spec.name: tune_cnn_batch_size_64
spec.description: 减小 batch size，观察梯度噪声和泛化效果的变化

spec.name: tune_cnn_epochs_6
spec.description: 缩短最大训练轮数，观察是否出现欠拟合

spec.name: tune_cnn_learning_rate_5e4
spec.description: 降低学习率，观察收敛速度与最终性能变化

spec.name: tune_cnn_weight_decay_0
spec.description: 去掉 L2 正则，观察正则化缺失后的效果变化

spec.name: tune_cnn_patience_1
spec.description: 更早触发早停，观察训练是否被过早截断

spec.name: tune_bigru_grad_clip_1
spec.description: 更强梯度裁剪，观察循环模型训练稳定性变化

spec.name: tune_cnn_seed_7
spec.description: 更换随机种子，评估结果的随机波动敏感性
